newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovnaft in petrol station joint venture in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Slovnaft in petrol station joint venture in Poland.

text.p: Slovakia's sole crude oil refiner, Slovnaft a.s., said on Thursday it had signed a contract setting up a joint-venture to build and operate up to 30 petrol stations in Poland by the year 2000.
"We are also in Poland now," Slovnaft spokesman Lubomir Zitnan told Reuters. He declined to provide any further details, including the name of the Polish partner.
He said the Krakow-based venture would be called Slovnaft-Polska a.s. and would carry Slovnaft's logo.
The venture's first station should start operations around the end of the year, Zitnan said.
Slovnaft currently has a 25-strong chain in the Czech Republic, and two "trial" petrol stations in the Ukraine.
Slovnaft controls some 310 petrol stations in Slovakia, accounting for over 75 percent of the domestic market.
